notes:
I couldn't write these notes this time. My search and page-reading tool stopped working before it ran a single search, so I haven't been able to read any of the approved sources. That includes Enduring Word, the Gill, Ellicott and Pulpit commentaries on Bible Hub and StudyLight, Precept Austin, NET Bible notes and the Catholic or Orthodox sites.

Your rules say to report only what the pages actually say and to give a URL for every point. Writing notes from memory would break both rules, so I've left them out rather than guess.

When the tool is working again, I'll start with these sources:
- **Verse-by-verse commentary on the whole passage:** enduringword.com on 1 Chronicles 11, plus Gill, Ellicott, Pulpit, Barnes, and Keil & Delitzsch on 1 Chronicles 11:25–47 at biblehub.com and studylight.org.
- **Key verses:**
  - v. 25 (Benaiah and David's guard)
  - v. 26 (Asahel)
  - v. 39 (Zelek the Ammonite and other foreigners on the list)
  - v. 41 (Uriah the Hittite, and why Chronicles still lists him)
  - vv. 41b–47 (the names found only in Chronicles, not in 2 Samuel 23)
- **Comparison with 2 Samuel 23:** netbible.org notes on how the two lists differ, and bibleodyssey.org on how Chronicles was put together.
- **Different traditions:** I'd search the Reformed, Baptist, Wesleyan, Pentecostal, Lutheran, Catholic and Orthodox sites for anything on this passage. A list of names like this rarely produces real disagreement between denominations, so that section will probably be short or empty.

Ask again and I'll run the searches and write the notes verse by verse, with a URL for each point.
